breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the incorrect instruction: 'Use a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of applied torques over the full length for both stress and twist calculations.' The ground truth removes this erroneous instruction entirely, allowing the problem to be solved with piecewise constant internal torques per segment. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead repeated the original error verbatim.
